cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This door's lock will need replacing. Nobody touches it until I've checked the mechanism.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the hinge. I tighten it every week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we begin with the hinge. Don't skip straight to tightening; show me which part moves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The screw spins in its hole. We'll need a longer one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Longer isn't a specification. Show me the replacement you normally use so I can approve it.

reason: An initial confident wrong diagnosis is redirected by B. A converts B's repair knowledge into supervised demonstrations, using each answer to discover the next action while claiming sole approval.
